description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Kittle was limited in Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Kittle remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's season opener coming off an Achilles tear. It is unclear if he'll be facing any sort of snap count on Thursday.
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) limited in practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Myles Garrett will be ready to go for Week 1's game against the 49ers.
items.impact: Garrett did not participate in Tuesday's practice. He is still expected to be good to go for his Rams debut on Thursday.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) expected to play Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Puka Nacua is not listed on the Rams initial injury report for Week 1.
items.impact: Puka has been dealing with a psoas injury for a little over a week, but his absence on the injury report is a big indication that barring a setback, he will play on Thursday. The star receiver should be a full go and lock into fantasy lineups.
items.title: Puka Nacua not listed on Rams first injury report

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love is improving as the Cardinals approach Week 1. When asked about Love's status for the season opener, HC Mike LaFleur said "I feel good."
items.impact: Love has been struggling with a high ankle sprain injury for a few weeks now, but this is a promising sign for his return. The first round rookie should be in line for a nice workload, and he flashed serious ability in his limited preseason action.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love: status improving for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Wilson practiced in full all week. He'll be in a depth role in the Seahawks backfield going into the season.
items.title: Emanuel Wilson (hamstring) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Julian Neal is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Neal is good to go heading into his debut on Wednesday.
items.title: Julian Neal (quad) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Anthony Bradford is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Bradford is fully good to go for Wednesday's season opener.
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: AJ Barner is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Barner practiced all week in full. He'll be a TE2 for fantasy managers going into the season.
items.title: AJ Barner (oblique) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Jones is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Jones will be good to go in his depth role on the offensive line for Seattle.
items.title: Josh Jones (knee) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tory Horton is listed as questionable for Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.
items.impact: Horton was limited in practice the past few days. His status is up in the air heading into Wednesday.
items.title: Tory Horton (hamstring) listed questionable Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Emmanwori was limited in practice the past few days. His status is up in the air heading into Wednesday's season opener.
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) listed questionable Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ty Okada has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Okada was unable to practice the past few days. The Seahawks will be short-handed at safety.
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) ruled out Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers reached agreement today on a three-year contract extension.
items.impact: This move comes out of no where as reports suggested talks between the two sides on an extension weren't going to continue this season. Mayfield lands his extension right before the start of the season.
items.title: Baker Mayfield signs three-year extension with Bucs

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian Barmore is off the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Barmore returned to a full practice on Monday. He will be good to go for Wednesday's season opener.
items.title: Christian Barmore (knee) off injury report Wednesday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 1 for the New England Patriots against the Seattle Seahawks according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Henderson will miss the season opener after being unable to practice to begin the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will see as many touches as he can handle against a strong Seattle front seven Wednesday night.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) ruled out for Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Aaron Donald has been ruled out for Week 1 for the Los Angeles Rams against the San Francisco 49ers according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Donald will not travel with the team for their Thursday night matchup against San Francisco in Australia as the superstar defensive tackle works back from two years in retirement.
items.title: Aaron Donald ruled out for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers have listed Mason Rudolph as their QB2 on the Week 1 depth chart.
items.impact: Will Howard is No. 3 and rookie Drew Allar is No. 4 on the opening depth chart as the Steelers kept all four quarterbacks on the roster.
items.title: Mason Rudolph listed as Steelers' QB2 on Week 1 depth chart

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Simmons is not expected to play in the Chiefs season opener against the Broncos.
items.impact: Simmons has been sidelined with a back injury. Chiefs coach Andy Reid said rookie UDFA Kahlil Benson would likely start at left tackle in Week 1.
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) not expected to play Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said rookie UDFA Kahlil Benson would likely start at left tackle in Week 1.
items.impact: Benson is likely to start in place of the injured Josh Simmons. It is not exactly ideal in Patrick Mahomes first start back off his torn ACL.
items.title: Kahlil Benson to likely start at left tackle Week 1 for Chiefs

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier was listed as the starting running back on the Cardinals' Week 1 depth chart.
items.impact: Allgeier was listed as the starter ahead of rookie Jeremiyah Love after a training camp battle. Love has also been making his way back from an ankle sprain, which could be why Allgeier sees more carries in the early part of the season. If he does indeed get the start on Sunday, Allgeier could be an RB3 or deeper flex option in fantasy.
items.title: Tyler Allgeier listed as starter on Cardinals depth chart

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Breece Hall is trending towards playing in Week 1, per HC Aaron Glenn. The running back will practice today.
items.impact: Hall was initially expected to be out two weeks with his groin injury, and this lines up well with his timeline. If he plays, he will be a high-end RB2 with RB1 upside.
items.title: Breece Hall (groin) trending towards playing Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Braxton Jones has officially been named the Bears starting left tackle.
items.impact: Jones re-signed with Chicago on a one-year contract back in March. He was competing for the left tackle job in camp with Jedrick Wills.
items.title: Braxton Jones named Bears starting left tackle

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bears CB Kyler Gordon is away from the team working with his own trainer to accelerate recovery.
items.impact: Gordon is expected to return a few weeks into the season and begin practicing shortly thereafter. He is on injured reserve to open the season with a calf injury.
items.title: Kyler Gordon (calf) away from Bears working with trainer

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Brandon Graham announced his retirement from the NFL on Tuesday.
items.impact: Graham will hang up his cleats after spending 16 seasons with the Eagles. The defensive end earned one Pro Bowl honor and won a pair of Super Bowls with the Eagles in his career, missing just one game from 2012 to 2020.
items.title: Brandon Graham announces retirement
